Name: James Wayne Wood
Space Grandpa Citation: Did not reach age 80; no qualifying 80+ activity possible.
Pre-NASA Career: US Army Air Corps pilot in WWII (10 combat missions); Korean War (100+ combat missions); USAF Test Pilot School graduate; experimental test pilot at Edwards AFB; X-20 Dyna-Soar senior test pilot 1960-1963 (slated for first flight); Commander of Test Operations, Edwards AFB; unsuccessful applicant for Mercury Seven

Name: Albert Hanlin Crews Jr.
Space Grandpa Citation: Attended NRO MOL 50th anniversary event at age 90 (June 2019); participated in PBS NOVA Astrospies documentary (2008, age 79); NASA oral history interview (2007, age 78); last surviving MOL astronaut
Pre-NASA Career: USAF pilot and test pilot; X-20 Dyna-Soar pilot 1962-1963; MOL astronaut 1965-1969; transferred to NASA JSC 1969; piloted Super Guppy, WB-57F, Shuttle simulator
Education: BS Chemical Engineering, University of Louisiana at Lafayette (1950); MS Aeronautical Engineering, Air Force Institute of Technology (1959)
Post-NASA Career: Retired from USAF as Colonel (1973); continued flying for NASA as civilian pilot until retirement (~1994); evaluated Space Shuttle competing designs
